|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Salacious Crumb (V)]] (version 2 of 2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).

Unless Crumb is 'hit', your leaders here may not be targeted by weapons. Undercover spies here are lost. ('AH-hahahaha!')”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 26 December 2025: “When deployed, may reveal the top two cards of your Reserve Deck; take one into hand and place the other in Used Pile. Unless Crumb is 'hit', your leaders here may not be targeted by weapons. Undercover spies here are lost. ('AH-hahahaha!')” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Salacious Crumb (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Salacious Crumb”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Salacious Crumb (V)]] (published 2 December 2025) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Salacious Crumb]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
